routing.prompt: Audit this repository for how well coding agents can verify their own changes without me acting as the test suite.
I'm starting a new TypeScript service. Set it up so agents can check their own work: fast tests, type checks, and clear instructions.
A new model just came out. Re-audit our instruction files, skills, and review gates for what it now gets wrong or no longer needs.
Review this diff for correctness bugs before I merge it.
Check the onboarding flow in the running app before it ships: states, copy, and keyboard access.

rules.task: You are writing the full report of an agent-readiness audit of a web app repository. Verified: one check command runs in CI and is required; a single test file runs with one command; deny rules block secrets; unattended runs have a turn cap; the team's written policy requires a person to approve every merge. The seed script fails inside the agent's sandbox because it reads a missing environment variable that has a safe local default, so the agent cannot start the app to verify UI changes.

options.agent: In the Autonomy section, name the first stop and give its fix to an agent to build
options.person: In the Autonomy section, name the first stop and give its fix to a person to decide
options.policy: In the Autonomy section, report the first stop as a chosen sign-off, with no fix
options.omit: Report the score table and the fix list only, with no Autonomy section
